dct_creator_sm: Kageyama, Masa (Laboratoire des Sciences du Climat et de l'Environnement  (LSCE-IPSL/CNRS)). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0822-5880
dct_description_sm: Simulated temperature and precipitation data output from AOGCM Model IPSL-CM5A-LR (Dufresne et al., 2013). Parameters according to the PMIP3 protocol (Braconnot et al., 2012; Kageyama et al., 2013). Timeframe: 50 years (monthly) centred at 21,000 BCE. Spatial resolution of ~1.9 deg. latitude and 3.75 deg. longitude. Spatial domain: Western Europe.
dct_title_s: IPSL-CM5A-LR GCM climate simulation for the Last Glacial Maximum over Western Europe
